title: Concatenating good run segments
statement: Let $N$ be a nondeterministic machine, let $C,C'$ be configurations, and let $S,T$ be natural numbers. Suppose every run from $C$ of length at most $S$ satisfies $\mathrm{box}$, and every run from $C$ of length exactly $S$ ends at $C'$. If every run from $C'$ of length at most $T$ satisfies $\mathrm{box}$ and every run from $C'$ of length exactly $T$ is halted and satisfies $Q$, then every run from $C$ of length at most $S+T$ satisfies $\mathrm{box}$, and every run from $C$ of length exactly $S+T$ is halted and satisfies $Q$.
